profile.summary: The Supreme Industries Limited manufactures and sells plastic products in India. The company offers plastic piping systems, including uPVC pipes, injection-molded PVC and handmade fittings; polypropylene random co-polymer pipe systems; HDPE and CPVC pipe systems; inspection chambers; manholes; bath fittings and sanitaryware; roto-molded tanks and fittings; solvents; industrial piping systems; DWC
